headline: Trevecca and West Alabama win away to meet again
dek: Trevecca won at Lee, the only side to have beaten them this season, and West Alabama won at AUM, where they had drawn in October. Trevecca have lost once in seventeen matches.
displaced_by: West Alabama won at AUM and Trevecca won at Lee; the standing dek's AUM figures (thirteen conceded, two defeats, neither to West Alabama) no longer hold.

pattern.text: West Alabama's goals have not bought a matching record: they have conceded 29 and won eight of their eighteen matches.

wire.line: West Alabama and Trevecca, the conference's highest-scoring sides, meet next after both won away.
